name: Moon rover traverse
location: Lunar south pole, away from the base
evacuation: Drive back to the base within hours; reaching Earth takes about 3 to 5 days.

healthFocus.title: Spacewalk effort and heat
healthFocus.detail: Moonwalks are hard physical work in a hot suit. Drink before and after, and watch your heart rate and temperature.

healthFocus.title: Lunar dust
healthFocus.detail: Fine, sharp dust can irritate the eyes, skin and lungs. Clean suits before entering and report coughing or eye irritation.

healthFocus.title: Small cabin, poor sleep
healthFocus.detail: Two people in a small rover for days. Noise, light and cramped sleep reduce rest; protect your sleep period.

healthFocus.title: No atmosphere or magnetic field
healthFocus.detail: Radiation is higher than on the space station. During a solar storm, use the rover's shielded area.
